name: ban-do
description: Animated map clips (MP4): zoom from a region to a country or city, highlight a country, a pin with a name, a big number; 9:16 or 16:9. Natural Earth data, drawn on your computer. Maps of Vietnam always show Hoàng Sa, Trường Sa and Biển Đông.
